entities.name: Japanese Tea Ceremony (Chanoyu)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Sen no Rikyū perfected chanoyu — the ritualized preparation and serving of matcha tea. Every gesture, utensil, and silence carries meaning. The tiny tea room equalizes all guests — samurai and merchants sit together. The four principles: harmony (wa), respect (kei), purity (sei), tranquility (jaku).
